name: Chiang Mai Old Town
rules: Choose long linen trousers over shorts; wats appear unannounced
Keep shoulders covered; a short-sleeve collared shirt works
Wear slip-on shoes; you'll take them off constantly

outfit.top: ecru linen camp-collar shirt, worn untucked
outfit.bottom: sand linen-blend drawstring trousers, cropped at the ankle

name: Hanoi evening
tagline: Smart layers for cool, damp nights
rules: Damp air feels colder; bring a real layer after dark
Put a knit or overshirt over a collared shirt
Go long trousers and closed shoes; save sandals for daytime

outfit.top: cream long-sleeve oxford or knit polo
outfit.bottom: charcoal tapered chinos or lightweight wool trousers
outfit.layer: navy unstructured overshirt or packable light jacket
outfit.shoes: dark brown suede loafers or minimal leather sneakers
outfit.accessory: light wool scarf for the wind

name: Sanctuary day
tagline: Muddy, wet, sunny: dress to get dirty
rules: Pick quick-dry synthetics or merino; skip cotton, denim, white
Back-strap sandals for rivers, closed shoes for mud
Long sleeves and a hat handle sun and grass

outfit.top: olive quick-dry long-sleeve shirt you don't mind ruining
outfit.bottom: dark quick-dry shorts, above the knee
outfit.layer: windproof shell for Ninh Binh boat rides
outfit.shoes: back-strap sport sandals with grippy soles
outfit.accessory: wide-brim bucket hat and rubber-strap watch

name: Temple day
tagline: Covered, respectful, easy to slip off
rules: Cover shoulders and knees; ankles too at the strictest sites
Nothing sheer, ripped, sleeveless or with rolled sleeves
Wear slip-ons and pack a sarong or scarf

outfit.top: light grey long-sleeve linen-cotton shirt, sleeves down
outfit.accessory: foldable sarong-style scarf in a small sling bag

name: Travel day
tagline: Comfortable in transit, sharp on arrival
rules: Wear your bulkiest pieces on the plane
Choose an untucked shirt and stretch chinos over sweats
Pack about ten pieces in colors that all combine

outfit.bottom: grey stretch chinos or drawstring trousers
outfit.accessory: compact crossbody sling for passport and phone

name: Minimal neutral
rules: Build on three neutrals plus one accent color
Vary texture within one color family
Light shades by day, darker tones at night

outfit.accessory: steel watch on a grey nylon strap
